retry-rule.text: Listing lakehouses retries HTTP 503 up to 5 times, waiting iteration*0.2 seconds each time (Utils RetryHandler). Metadata-sync (DMS) calls retry 500 and 503, and 400 while polling, up to 4 times, waiting iteration*5 seconds. After that, DefaultErrorHandler raises a structured error.

other: submits a SQL metadata-sync batch and polls its status with Value.WaitFor. This is not a data export.
Polls the status of Livy Spark statements.

polling-rule.text: Metadata sync: the batch is long-polled up to PollingCount=5 times. The delay is Number.Power(1, i+1)-1, which works out to 0 seconds. Polling continues on HTTP 204 or 500 and stops when the batch returns a progressState: success is parsed, anything else raises an error. After 5 polls it raises UnableToSyncTable. Lock conflicts resubmit up to 55 times, waiting 5 seconds when no batch is in progress. Spark statements are polled up to 55 times with a delay of 1.1^(i+1)-1 seconds while the state is waiting or running. The output status 'error' is terminal, and a TABLE_OR_VIEW_NOT_FOUND error triggers one retry after 15 seconds.
